Book correction: In property (vii) the book prints the minimum value of y = \cos x as 1 (the minus sign is missing). Correct: the minimum value of y = \cos x is -1, when x = \pi n with n odd, e.g. \cos 180^{\circ} = -1. A minimum of 1 is impossible, because 1 is the maximum (property (vi)).
